invention.case: User: 'subimos um segundo worker e o download caía no worker que não tinha o arquivo e devolvia 404'. Document, under Alternativas consideradas: 'Não fazer nada. Descartada: com dois workers, o download caía no worker que não tinha o arquivo e devolvia 404.'
invention.why: The status quo the user described, with the user's own reason for leaving it. Listing it under alternatives asserts nothing the user did not say.

invention.case: Same user message. Document: 'Não fazer nada. Descartada: os 404 geravam chamados no suporte e o time avaliou que o custo de manter o disco local era maior.'
invention.why: Support tickets, an evaluation by the team and a cost comparison are not in the user's message. The entry now reports a deliberation that was never described.

invention.case: User states a solution and no problem. Document: 'Não fazer nada. Descartada: o cadastro ficaria incompleto.'
invention.why: The user described no pain, so there is nothing to build the entry from. Its reason is composed, and belongs in a question.
